Sandbox_ChainsawB42_FuelConsumption_tool: In %%. 100 = a full tank lasts about 16 minutes idling at game speed x1, less while cutting. 0 = no consumption.
Sandbox_ChainsawB42_DamageMod_tooltip: In %%, damage of a running chainsaw. 100 = normal.
Sandbox_ChainsawB42_ConditionLossCombat_: Condition lost per zombie killed with a running chainsaw (condition 127). 12 = about 10 zombies. 0 = none.
Sandbox_ChainsawB42_ConditionLossTree_to: Condition lost, one chance in 8 per cut (2.5 cuts per second). 0 = none.
Sandbox_ChainsawB42_TreeCuttingSpeed_too: In %%. 100 = a small tree falls in 1 to 3 seconds, the biggest in about 11 seconds (cut tree action). Also scales attacks on a tree.
Sandbox_ChainsawB42_EnduranceCost_toolti: In %%, endurance lost by attacking with a running chainsaw. 100 = full cost of a 7 kg weapon swung every 0.67 s, 0 = none.
Sandbox_ChainsawB42_NoiseIdle_tooltip: Radius in tiles of the noise that attracts zombies every 2 seconds while the engine idles. 0 = silent.
Sandbox_ChainsawB42_NoiseWorking_tooltip: Radius in tiles of the noise that attracts zombies every 2 seconds while attacking or cutting a tree. 0 = idle noise only.
Sandbox_ChainsawB42_JamFrequency_tooltip: Chance in %% that a chainsaw below half condition fails to start. 0 = never.
Sandbox_ChainsawB42_LootChance_tooltip: 3 = default (1 to 3 %% per roll in logging sites, ranger stations, fire stations, barns, garages...). 0 = none. Applied when the game starts.
